question.text:
Given below are two statements :

Statement I : Non-biodegradable wastes are generated by the thermal power plants.

Statement II : Bio-degradable detergents leads to eutrophication.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the option given below:

options.text: Both statement I and statement II are false
Statement I is true but statement II is false
Statement I is false but statement II is true
Both statement I and statement II are true.

solution.text: Non-biodegradable wastes are generated by the thermal power plants, which produces fly ash. Detergents which are biodegradable cause problem called eutrophication which kills animal life by depriving it of oxygen.
